microdoc.title: Promise of Pramaana
microdoc.desc: A micro documentary on the meeting of ancient mathematical wisdom and modern computational proof systems, following Pramaana Labs as they turn centuries of knowledge into verifiable frameworks.

events.title: Verification Summit, inaugural edition
events.desc: The first Verification Summit, anchored by Vinod Khosla. I built the storytelling around it, including the film made for the room, AI Stops Saying Sorry.

events.title: Follow The Frontier
events.desc: BoldCap's invite-only series that brings researchers and builders into one room to follow what is actually moving at the frontier.

events.title: OpenAI Demo Party x BoldCap
events.desc: A demo party for builders rather than a conference. The film from the night is in the videos above.

websites.title: Pramaana Labs
websites.desc: Website design and brand storytelling for an AI verification lab. The brand had to make formal proof feel like trust, not like mathematics.

websites.title: BoldCap
websites.desc: Brand identity, website and narrative strategy for the fund I work at. The thesis on the site is written the way the partners talk.

shows.title: Attention Is All You Need
shows.desc: A solo essay-film show about the gap between frontier AI and the culture it lands in. Episode one is the manifesto; episode two is on the future of fashion.
